sloka: पुरोहितं च काकुत्स्थं नैगमानृत्विजस्तथा ।मन्त्रिणश्चैव तान्सर्वानानयध्वं ममाज्ञया ।। ७.६३.११ ॥
transliteration: purohitaṁ ca kākutsthaṁ naigamānṛtvijastathā ।mantriṇaścaiva tānsarvānānayadhvaṁ mamājñayā ।। 7.63.11 ॥

translations.english: Rama further instructed them to bring the chief priest, the citizens, the ritual priests, and all the ministers by his command.
